name: Smoked Salmon, Asparagus, Goat Cheese & Dill Frittata with Green Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 small bunch asparagus
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 pint grape tomatoes
1 English cucumber
1 (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a large bowl.
Add eggs, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the dill; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
10 eggs
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl; stir to combine and set aside.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Slice crosswise into ½-inch pieces and place in another large bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add asparagus, green onions, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until asparagus is crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet with the veggies; gently stir to combine. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 6-7 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the frittata is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
4 tsp red wine vinegar
2 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes. Trim and medium dice cucumber; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Finely chop walnuts and add to the bowl along with the mixed greens; toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
